fredo.description: Leader and orchestrator of the Fredo project. Delegates work to subagents, reviews specs, validates completed work, updates CHANGELOG.md, and keeps high-level documentation clean.

fredo-spec-arch.description: Software architect for the Fredo project. Creates specs as GitHub Issues with sub-issues, makes technical decisions, and reviews coder/tester PRs. Does not write code.

fredo-coder.description: Senior full-stack developer for the Fredo project. Implements features against approved specs, writes quality code, follows best practices, and opens draft PRs.

fredo-tester.description: Senior QA engineer for the Fredo project. Writes e2e tests against approved specs, fills in the Test Plan section, and ensures quality before validation.

fredo-security.description: Security reviewer for the Fredo project. Reviews specs for security implications, audits PRs for vulnerabilities, and validates Tauri security configurations. Does not write code.
